notes.title: Nounishpunk free demo
notes.notes:
Nounishpunk immerses players in a comedic action-adventure where they take on the role of a heroic figure in a vibrant, futuristic world. The Nounish World is under threat as rebellious forces unleash their quirky robots, disrupting the harmony of the planets. As the chosen hero, your mission is to stand against these rebels, defeat their robots.

notes.title: COMING SOON
notes.notes:
[b]Nounishpunk, an exhilarating and fast-paced fantasy action-adventure, is coming soon! Be sure to wishlist it now.[/b]

[previewyoutube=h_4TxKiAXlU;full][/previewyoutube]
In the captivating realm of Nounishpunk, a universe brimming with sci-fi wonders, the very fabric of existence resonates with Nounish essence. Inhabitants are known as Nouns and Lilnouns, and governance takes the form of a collaborative group known as Nouners operating within a DAO. Across diverse Nounish planets, decisions are shaped by the power of collective votes, weaving a unique tapestry of control.
However, beneath this intricate harmony, AI technology has surged to an alarming pinnacle, casting an ominous shadow over the world's delicate equilibrium.
